text: doc Google Drive file, anything [googledrive::as_id()] accepts – typically full share URL copied browser. post_name Name post folder create, e.g. "2026-09-09--title". TRUE, replaces `index.qmd` inside . intermediate `index.md` downloaded doc always replaced regardless setting, previously failed call can always retried. authors_sheet Google Sheet, anything [googlesheets4::read_sheet()] accepts, mapping author's alias (used doc's `Authors:` field) full name ORCID. title: blogscapes (development version)
text: package errors, warnings, messages now use {cli} clearer, consistent formatting (#27). crosspost_blog()’s returned targets now also includes post’s source repo (named "source"), just destination copies, [open_crosspost_prs()] also branches/commits/pushes/opens PR – post new source repo needs treatment (#55). crosspost_blog() now copies post’s source content – .qmd/.Rmd, referenced images, references.bib present – instead whole post folder, Quarto render output left behind local preview (.html, *_files/, .quarto/, site_libs/) longer crossposted (#50). google_doc_to_qmd() now resolves authors’ names ORCIDs Openscapes team’s authors/ORCID Google Sheet instead CSV bundled package, new authors can added without package rebuild. new authors_sheet argument lets overridden (#20). google_doc_to_qmd()’s Authors: field now accepts either author’s short alias full name, matching whichever file authors sheet (#43). google_doc_to_qmd() now strips base64 data: URI images post body (e.g. emoji pasted Slack, Google Docs exports inline images), replacing plain alt text instead carrying embedded image data generated .qmd (#49). open_crosspost_prs()’s branch argument now optional, defaulting "crosspost-<post folder name>" derived targets instead requiring retyped (kept sync) hand (#52). open_crosspost_prs() longer fails stage target’s files path component resolves symlink (e.g. /var -> /private/var macOS), previously produced “staged files commit” error (#52). open_crosspost_prs() now attempts every target independently instead stopping first failure – problem one destination repo longer prevents branches/PRs created others. targets fail, one error lists every target attempted (#54). verify_post_images() crosspost_blog() longer double-count double-copy image ’s referenced post (e.g. used cover image inline figure) – previously made crosspost_blog() fail EEXIST error trying copy file twice (#61). verify_post_images() now reports success message naming many images checked, instead returning silently (#46).
